adc.scope: Use all original two-strip windows with the frozen late-step calculation. Keep both measured X/Y alternatives and original order/projected/unresolved weights. Weak strips are positive preamp steps between five modeled standard deviations and the nominal collection threshold.
adc.limits: Five late samples, the modeled noise and the short quiet reference define this diagnostic. Rail codes anywhere in the window exclude that contact. A persistent step alone is an ADC observation in keV-equivalent; carrier endpoints and measured energy are separate quantities.

native.clock_scope: Require one unique clock group and no additional native current on the ADC support. Preserve proximity labels, including prior analog history outside the native-current test.
native.endpoint_reference: Match each saved carrier endpoint to its contact. Sum original deposited energy once per face as charge-equivalent input using the nominal ionization model. A weak endpoint lies in the inclusive lower and exclusive upper fixed ADC amplitude band.
native.induced_reference: Use signed wired native charge, linearly sampled at the original window times, without the preamplifier or noise. The terminal residual is native wire charge minus endpoint-assigned input. It may contain weighting-field and endpoint effects. Its magnitude at or above the 5-sigma amplitude scale flags a contribution worth separating.
native.near_sensitivity: Positive endpoint input or terminal wired signal lies within one modeled sigma of the fixed 5-sigma lower boundary.
native.positive_scope: Other non-guard, noncollector strips; ADC saturation and unavailable settling are withheld.
native.trigger_comparison: Any ADC positive versus any weak endpoint among comparable strips in the trigger. Matched-contact, missed-contact and false-positive-contact trigger counts separately retain mismatches when a trigger has positives on both sides.

ideal_endpoint_pairing.ideal_strips: Sum original Ge deposited energies by their saved X and Y carrier-endpoint contacts. Keep all original endpoint cells in the marginal sums and hold the four measured collector IDs fixed. Apply both permutations at the existing pairing tolerance.
ideal_endpoint_pairing.partial_support: Record any original Ge deposition whose two endpoints do not both lie on the four measured collectors. Guards and other outside contacts are counted separately. A deposit can enter one face marginal and be absent from the other.
ideal_endpoint_pairing.interpretation: The result uses simulation endpoint truth. An occupied cell represents charge routed to an endpoint intersection. Counting cells does not infer sites from the ADC.
